title: Motor: correct the 2025 level for the measured development over-estimate of the latest year (#151)
reason: Merged into C1. On the production basis (D-11 on), applying A25's x1.035/x1.055 (BI x1.087/x1.134) double counts. Those biases were measured with IBNER off on both sides (AUDIT_LOG A17 item 1), and against D-11's lifted actual BF was x1.001 / x0.933. It only applies coherently once D-11 is removed.

title: Net open motor own-damage and theft claims of their expected recoveries (target definition)
reason: Duplicate of 'Deduct expected recoveries from open motor own-damage and theft claims'. Merged into C12; the counts and ratios were verified in this review.

title: Buildings: scale rows of 36 days or less (exposure <= 0.1) to about 0.4 of pro rata
reason: Merged into C7 with the buildings exposure-elasticity proposal. This review's capped probe puts the effect in large claims, not small-claim severity, so the excess-GLM form is preferred.

title: Exposure elasticity for buildings large claims (prediction proportional to exposure^b, b about 1.05-1.1)
Seed-bag the buildings XGBoost (average 5 seeds, with the larger tree count)
reason: Merged into C11 with tree-count scaling. Against production it fails 2023 (-0.00007), and against the seed average it is below the noise floor (+0.00026/+0.00025). It is kept only inside C11 because the 2023 baseline is selection-inflated: tune_trees early-stops on 2023 with the production seed.

title: Buildings: seed-bag the XGBoost small-claim model and use the bag as the comparison baseline
reason: Merged into C11. On its own it is below the noise floor (+0.00019/+0.00018 against the average seed; -0.00033/+0.00005 against production).

title: Scale the buildings XGBoost tree count with the fitting data, instead of reusing the 2021-22 early-stopped count
reason: Kept as the base of merged C11 (listed here for completeness).

title: Buildings: one-parameter calibration slope (auto-calibration) on the predicted rate
reason: Merged into C3 with the dispersion (power) recalibration, which is the same one-parameter stretch. This review's probe on mu deciles confirms +0.00037/+0.00049.

title: Buildings peril-aware credibility: subsidence claims weight 0, flood/storm weight 1.5-2, against per-peril expected counts
reason: Below the noise floor: +0.00022 on 2023 with the fixed weights (+0.00009 when the weights are chosen on 2024). Neither year is significant (2023 -0.00023 to +0.00071), and it needs six extra GLMs per window. Not tested before (sql/12 has no peril), but the measured gain does not clear about +0.0003 on both years.

title: Log-scale spline knots for contents elevation and river distance
reason: 2023 gain +0.00022 (log1p, 4 knots) and +0.00005 to +0.00016 for the raw-knot variants are below the noise floor. About 12 variants were tried, and the reviewer expects it to fail D-23.

title: Exposure elasticity below 1 for contents (short rows claim more per day)
reason: 2024 is below the noise floor in every measurement: the refit at a=0.95 gives +0.00026, and this review's probe on exposure bands gives +0.00020 (scored 2024) / +0.00029 (scored 2023). The 2023-tuned a=0.8 fails 2024 (-0.00016). It has the opposite sign to buildings and interacts with D-22 seasonal exposure.

title: Motor: credibility-weight the large-claim relativities towards the small-claim model's shape
reason: 2023 gain below the noise floor: +0.00022 with w fixed at 0.5, and +0.00008 with w taken from 2024. Neither yearly interval excludes zero. It overlaps C8, which addresses the same flat or noisy motor excess relativities with a stronger 2023 result.
